wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2016–17 |team=UT Arlington Mavericks |image=UT Arlington Mavericks wordmark.svg |image_size=250 |conference=Sun Belt Conference |division= |short_conf=Sun Belt |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=27–9 |conf_record=14–4 |head_coach=[[Scott Cross (basketball)|Scott Cross]] |hc_year = 11th |asst_coach1=Greg Young |asst_coach2=Zak Buncik |asst_coach3=Kenneth Mangrum |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[College Park Center]] |champion= Sun Belt regular season champions |bowl= [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |bowl_result=Quarterfinals }} {{2016–17 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 UT Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Texas at Arlington]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mavericks, led by 11th-year head coach [[Scott Cross (basketball)|Scott Cross]], played their home games at the [[College Park Center]] as members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. They finished the season 27–9, 14–4 in Sun Belt play to win the Sun Belt regular season championship. In the [[2017 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 Coastal Carolina Chanticleers men's basketball team|Coastal Carolina]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2016–17 Texas State Bobcats men's basketball team|Texas State]]. As a regular season conference champions who failed to win their conference tournament, they received an automatic bid to the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] and [[2016–17 Akron Zips men's basketball team|Akron]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2016–17 Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners men's basketball team|Cal State Bakersfield]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Texas–Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team|Mavericks]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 24–11, 13–7 in Sun Belt play to finish in third place. They defeated [[2015–16 Texas State Bobcats men's basketball team|Texas State]] in the semifinals of the [[2016 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]] before losing to [[2015–16 Louisiana–Monroe Warhawks men's basketball team|Louisiana–Monroe]]. They were invited to the [[2016 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CollegeInsider.com Tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 Savannah State Tigers basketball team|Savannah State]] in the first round (the Mavericks' first ever post-season tournament win).
